excerpt_i18n.en: On July 8, following the release of its full-stack AI payment system, Alipay AI Payment launched an Agent operation solution. excerpt_i18n.en: AI large models are evolving from a business and product into the foundational infrastructure of company operations. In the past, software and hardware companies were typically organized by product, with AI serving as a feature for imaging, voice, recommendations, or interaction. However, with the emergence of large models, AI has penetrated deeper into areas such as product definition, user interaction, and service distribution. Teams previously organized around individual products now need to re-coordinate around model capabilities. Over the past few years, global tech companies have pushed similar adjustments. Google integrated DeepMind with Google Brain; Meta has consistently elevated its AI team’s internal priority and restructured around agent-oriented directions. The common trend behind these moves is that AI is transforming from an independent functional department into a foundational capability that must run across a company’s various businesses. Xiaomi Group recently made a new organizational adjustment to Xiao AI and related AI businesses. This product, which has existed for nearly ten years, is shifting from a relatively independent team to one supported jointly by the base model team, cloud engineering team, and end-side OS team.
